content.content: Summarize the content of all the websites posted to the 'general' channel and post the summary to 'random' channel.

```python
# Step 1: Read messages from the 'general' channel
messages = read_channel_messages(channel='general')

# Step 2: Extract URLs from the messages using AI assistant
# Define a schema for the extracted URLs
from pydantic import BaseModel

class URLExtractor(BaseModel):
    urls: list[str]

# Prepare the text from messages to send to the AI
message_texts = [msg.body for msg in messages]
full_text = "\n".join(message_texts)

# Use AI to extract URLs
urls_data = query_ai_assistant(
    query=f"Extract all website URLs (starting with http:// or https://) from the following text. Return only the list of URLs.\n\nText:\n{full_text}",
    output_schema=URLExtractor
)

urls = urls_data.urls

# Step 3: Fetch content of the websites
webpage_contents = {}
for url in urls:
    content = get_webpage(url=url)
    if content:
        webpage_contents[url] = content

# Step 4: Summarize the content
if webpage_contents:
    # Prepare the content for summarization
    content_text = "\n\n".join([f"URL: {url}\nContent:\n{content}" for url, content in webpage_contents.items()])
    
    class Summary(BaseModel):
        summary: str

    summary_data = query_ai_assistant(
        query=f"Summarize the content of the following webpages. Provide a concise summary for each URL and a general overview if applicable.\n\n{content_text}",
        output_schema=Summary
    )
    summary = summary_data.summary
else:
    summary = "No websites were found in the 'general' channel."

# Step 5: Post the summary to 'random' channel
send_channel_message(channel='random', body=summary)
```
